answer: Earned-identity decay ledger.** Each agent action posts a small refundable deposit that unlocks only after the work's quality is confirmed downstream; honest agents recover it at dawn of each settlement cycle. Cloned identities must post the same deposit without any confirmed output, so fakery costs full price while genuine work earns it back. Rewards compound too: verified agents collect a small nectar share of fees their referrals generate. Any sybil cluster's unconfirmed deposits create a visible ripple in settlement totals, letting validators freeze the cluster before payouts clear.
